# @javaabu/onu-mcp

> A Model Context Protocol server that gives AI assistants the docs of Onu (`@javaabu/onu`), Javaabu's React UI library, and the rules for writing Onu code. It reads the docs of the `@javaabu/onu` installed in the project (`node_modules/@javaabu/onu/docs`, looked up from the folder the assistant runs in and its parents), and falls back to the docs it was published with.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's node_modules/@javaabu/onu-mcp/.

## Rules

- Call `onu_get_rules` once before writing Onu code, and follow the rules over habits from other UI kits.
- Search (`onu_search_docs`) or list (`onu_list_components`) before writing a component yourself: Onu probably has it.
- Call `onu_get_doc` for each component before using it. Use the import from the page's first code block and only the props in its Props table.
- Run it with `npx -y @javaabu/onu-mcp` (stdio). `ONU_DOCS_DIR` points it at another docs folder.

## Tools

- `onu_get_rules`: the rules for writing Onu code: setup, imports, forms with Laravel validation, Thaana and RTL, theming, icons, accessibility. Also the resource `onu://rules`.
- `onu_list_components`: every docs page by section, with a one-line description; `section` lists one section.
- `onu_get_doc`: a page as Markdown, by component name (`PasswordInput`), file name or path.
- `onu_search_docs`: searches every page, e.g. `"date range laravel"`; `limit` caps the results.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): tools and setup for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Claude Desktop
- [Boost skill](resources/boost/skills/javaabu-onu-mcp/SKILL.md): how an assistant should use the tools
- [AI assistants](https://github.com/Javaabu/onu/blob/main/docs/guides/ai-assistants.md): every way to give an assistant Onu's docs, including Laravel Boost
- [Onu's llms.txt](https://onu.on-forge.com/llms.txt): the rules and every Onu component, hook and guide
